subject.title: fix(memory): keep implicit embeddings recall available

question: Should unavailable implicit or legacy-auto OpenAI embeddings intentionally preserve read-only lexical recall from a compatible existing index instead of reporting memory search unavailable?
rationale: The patch is evidence-backed and does not add configuration, but it changes the observable failure behavior and persisted-index compatibility promise for existing users; that choice is product and ownership intent rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the documented compatibility mode
options.body: Merge the branch and make FTS-only read-only recall the supported behavior for implicit and legacy-auto OpenAI embeddings without API-key authentication.

options.title: Keep failure semantics
options.body: Request a narrower alternative that preserves the prior unavailable-search result until a separate, explicitly approved recovery mode exists.

recommendation.title: Accept the documented compatibility mode
recommendation.body: Merge the branch and make FTS-only read-only recall the supported behavior for implicit and legacy-auto OpenAI embeddings without API-key authentication.
